description: In-memory key-value store with TTL expiration
prompt: Implement a class `TTLStore` with `set(key, value, ttl: float, now: float) -> None` (expires at `now + ttl`), `get(key, now: float)` (returns the value, or `None` if missing or expired as of `now`), using a simulated clock (`now` passed explicitly, no real time).
